answer_1.quote: The task of Grammatical Error Correction (GEC) automatically detects and corrects grammatical errors in a given text ...

answer_2.quote: We compute Pearson (γ) and Spearman (ρ) correlations between metrics and human judgments, in order to ascertain the effectiveness and robustness of GEC metrics within the context of system-level ranking.

answer_3.quote: We prompt Llama-2-7B to assign edit weights from 1 to 5, where a higher value signifies more critical edits.

answer_4.quote: We conduct comprehensive experiments across two human judgment datasets ... Three native English speakers participate in the annotation process ... overall human rankings are derived from Expected Wins (EW) and TrueSkill (TS) methods.
answer_4.guideline: Humans rank system outputs from best to worst using Expected Wins and TrueSkill criteria.
